Synopsis:
Republican Senate and Congressional committees are petitioning the U.S. Supreme Court to block a 4th Circuit ruling that denied party committees access to the FCC's "lowest unit charge" discounted broadcast ad rates. With tens of millions already budgeted under the now-blocked policy, Republicans — holding a significant cash advantage (~$279M vs. Democrats' ~$136M) — are racing to preserve cheaper airtime ahead of the 60-day pre-election window opening imminently before the November midterms.
